facts.fact: 上班时亚当收到哥哥发来的短信，说医院里有东西要给他看。
facts.anchor: He checked the screen and saw that it was from his brother.

facts.fact: 「Wonder Bread」这个外号是亚当的老板杰西（Jesse）给起的，而杰西正好也是 Vic 的兄弟。
facts.anchor: given to Adam by his boss, Jesse, who also happened to be Vic’s brother

facts.fact: 波比（Bobby）是亚当的哥哥，在一家归精灵所有的医院工作——那只是亚当对那地方心情复杂的原因之一。
facts.anchor: The hospital where Adam’s brother worked was owned by the elves, which was only one reason why he had mixed feelings

facts.fact: 波比带他们看了其他病房，亚当并不意外地看到科尔也在这些病人之中。
facts.anchor: Adam wasn’t surprised to see Cole among the patients.

facts.fact: 波比的妻子安妮（Annie）曾去世，如今复活归来并怀有身孕——那是他们最大的希望。
facts.anchor: since his wife had died, with Annie returning to life and a baby—their biggest hope—on the way

facts.fact: 波比把床上的年轻人登记为特里斯坦·雷耶斯（Tristan Reyez），并说还有五个（five more）和他一模一样的病人。
facts.anchor: “I have him down as Tristan Reyez,” Bobby said. “We have five more just like him.

facts.fact: 杜特已学会用智能手机——对精灵而言是巨大的飞跃；因守护者那边有能破解任何系统的技术感应者图书管理员杰克（Jack），他与亚当的短信仍用暗号交流。
facts.anchor: Dautre had figured out smartphones, a monumental leap for an elf.

facts.fact: 这不是附身（possession）而是置换（displacement）——那人的灵魂被整个从身体里扯走了。
facts.anchor: This wasn’t possession. It was displacement. The man’s spirit had been ripped out of him.
